item.title: AI in Healthcare- Employee Whistleblower and Retaliation Complaints—What You Need to Know
item.description: As artificial intelligence (AI) tools integrate into clinical labs and diagnostics, healthcare employers face greater risk of whistleblower and retaliation claims by employees who report concerns about how these tools are being used. item.title: When Night Falls, ADA Still Applies: Sixth Circuit Recognizes Night Blindness as a Disability
item.description: On November 7, 2025, the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit ruled that, in some cases, night blindness may be considered a disability under the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). In Edwards v. Shelby County, Tennessee, the court upheld a jury verdict finding that the employer discriminated against an employee because of her night blindness and retaliated against her after she requested an accommodation. item.title: New Executive Order to Establish a National AI Policy Framework
item.description: The White House has issued an executive order that establishes a national policy framework for artificial intelligence (“AI”). The order, titled “Ensuring a National Policy Framework for Artificial Intelligence” (the “Order”), was signed on December 11, 2025. The Order prioritizes a “minimally burdensome” federal approach that is intended to promote and maintain U.S. AI leadership. item.description: The January 2026 Visa Bulletin appears to deliver positive developments for employment-based immigration, with notable forward movement across most categories. item.title: Buyer Beware - New Restrictions on the Purchase and Sale of Medical Equipment Companies
item.description: Durable Medical Equipment (DME) owners and prospective purchasers need to be aware of a new Medicare rule that significantly restricts the transfer of ownership in these types of companies. Failure to be aware of the new restriction could result in a buyer ending up with a company that cannot bill Medicare. item.title: ‘Tis the Season
item.description: ‘Tis the Season… You probably do not think of HR compliance when you hear the phrase. item.title: Building Thought Leadership That Drives Business
item.description: In today’s professional services market, being technically excellent is only part of the equation. Lawyers, consultants, accountants, and financial advisors are discovering that expertise alone does not automatically translate into opportunity.
